build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with configurable column center, width, and bar heights using creator_lib
create_cos_helper: create a helper function that computes cosine of an angle given in degrees
add_scene_elements: add static bars, dynamic balls, and dynamic bars to a PHYRE scene with spatial constraints
update_task_relationships: update the task to require a ball touching a target bar using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.PRE_TWO_BALLS to classify difficulty level
